feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
entry.summary: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

entry.title: Betel nuts are a top mind-affecting substance. Now there's evidence of ancient use
entry.summary: New research on ancient human remains suggests the habitual usage of betel nuts, a plant seed with mind-affecting properties that is popular in parts of Asia despite the health risks it presents.

entry.title: Here are 8 movies we loved at the Toronto International Film Festival
entry.summary: A thoughtful comedy starring Seth Rogen and Anna Kendrick, a haunting adaptation of Mrs. Dalloway set in Lagos, and a (possible?) swan song from acclaimed filmmaker Mike Leigh stood out at TIFF.

entry.title: Archaeologists are racing to save precious artifacts in Alaska after last year's storm
entry.summary: Last year, remnants of a typhoon damaged homes, infrastructure and an archaeological dig site. Now, archaeologists are trying to get as many objects out as possible before the next storm.

entry.title: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

entry.title: Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war
entry.summary: Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.

entry.title: As Europe warms, Italy sees West Nile virus spread
entry.summary: Italian health authorities see evidence that rising temperatures and longer warm seasons are helping mosquitoes spread West Nile virus across a wider area, during more months of the year.

entry.title: U.S. and Denmark reach deal to build U.S. military presence in Greenland
entry.summary: President Trump says he has a deal with Denmark to bolster the U.S. military presence in Greenland. The announcement comes after months of threatening to take the island by force from the NATO ally.

entry.title: Editor Rose Friedman, who helped shape NPR's cultural coverage, dies at 38
entry.summary: Friedman was in her early 20s when she landed her first position as an editorial assistant at NPR. She became an editor and reporter, and a co-creator of the annual Books We Love reading guide.

entry.title: Alaska's salmon-feasting bears face off in biggest Fat Bear Week ever
entry.summary: This year's single-elimination tournament will see 16 competitors face off, compared to 12 in past years. Officials report more cubs in Katmai National Park than they've seen in recent memory.
